newsitem.title: GERMANY: German IBIS DAX hits all-time high in pre-bourse.
newsitem.headline: German IBIS DAX hits all-time high in pre-bourse.

text.p: Germany's IBIS DAX share index climbed more than one percent early on Monday to hit a record all-time high of 2,955.76 in pre-bourse trade.
That was up 39.95 points or 1.37 percent from Friday's after-bourse close.
Traders said a record high close on Wall Street on Friday combined with a recovery on Japan's Nikkei share index lifted German shares. Bourse trade starts at 0930 GMT.
